title: Concerns of fraud, corruption and misconduct
summary: This page provides information on how to report concerns regarding fraud, corruption, or misconduct within Service NSW.
who_can_apply: Citizens and employees who have concerns about fraud, corruption, or misconduct.
what_you_need: An email address to create or log in to your Whispli account.
Knowledge of the specific type of misconduct (e.g., corrupt conduct, maladministration).

faqs.q: How can I report concerns about fraud, corruption, or misconduct?
faqs.a: You can report concerns using the DCS Whispli reporting platform. You will need to select the 'Public Interest Disclosures Reports' button, create or log in to your Whispli account, and complete and submit a PID Form.

faqs.q: Who are the people who can receive a report?
faqs.a: A report can be submitted to the Secretary of DCS, the head of Service NSW, a disclosure officer, or your manager.

faqs.q: What types of misconduct can I report?
faqs.a: You can report corrupt conduct, serious maladministration, serious and substantial waste of public money, a government information contravention, a privacy contravention, or a local government pecuniary interest contravention.
